about.summary: XGrammar is an open-source library for efficient, flexible, and portable structured generation.

script:
export CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
if [[ $(uname) == "Linux" ]]; then
  export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -Wno-dangling-reference"
  # Disable LTO to avoid linker issues with tvm_ffi shared library
  export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -isystem $PREFIX/include -fno-lto"
  export LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS -fno-lto"
fi
if [[ "${CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION:-}" == "1" ]]; then
  # Cross-compilation fixes for tvm_ffi:
  # 1. Write a custom cmake config that hardcodes host env paths (the upstream config
  #    uses Python_EXECUTABLE to discover paths, which picks up build-arch libs).
  export TVM_FFI_DIR=$PREFIX/lib/python${PY_VER}/site-packages/tvm_ffi
  TVM_FFI_CMAKE=$SRC_DIR/tvm_ffi_override
  mkdir -p $TVM_FFI_CMAKE
  sed -e "s|\${TVM_FFI_DIR}|${TVM_FFI_DIR}|g" -e "s|\${SHLIB_EXT}|${SHLIB_EXT}|g" \
    $RECIPE_DIR/tvm_ffi-cross.cmake.in > $TVM_FFI_CMAKE/tvm_ffi-config.cmake
  export CMAKE_ARGS="$CMAKE_ARGS -Dtvm_ffi_ROOT=$TVM_FFI_CMAKE"
  # 2. Disable stub generation post-build step (it uses ctypes.CDLL to load the
  #    cross-compiled library which fails: arm64 lib on x86_64 host).
  sed 's/STUB_DIR.*STUB_INIT ON//' cpp/tvm_ffi/CMakeLists.txt > cpp/tvm_ffi/CMakeLists.txt.tmp
  mv cpp/tvm_ffi/CMakeLists.txt.tmp cpp/tvm_ffi/CMakeLists.txt
fi
${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
if [[ "${CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION:-}" == "1" ]]; then
  bash $RECIPE_DIR/create_ffi_stubs.sh
fi

tests.script: python -m pytest tests/ -m "not hf_token_required" -k "not MELODY and not cohere_melody and not metal"

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: xgrammar
  version: "0.2.8"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/xgrammar-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 8305646fd2b319d6c3003f51a1665e54cbbe9cba1fb636bc41d0b46434ccbb80

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    - if: unix
      then: |
        export CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
        if [[ $(uname) == "Linux" ]]; then
          export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -Wno-dangling-reference"
          # Disable LTO to avoid linker issues with tvm_ffi shared library
          export CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -isystem $PREFIX/include -fno-lto"
          export LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS -fno-lto"
        fi
        if [[ "${CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION:-}" == "1" ]]; then
          # Cross-compilation fixes for tvm_ffi:
          # 1. Write a custom cmake config that hardcodes host env paths (the upstream config
          #    uses Python_EXECUTABLE to discover paths, which picks up build-arch libs).
          export TVM_FFI_DIR=$PREFIX/lib/python${PY_VER}/site-packages/tvm_ffi
          TVM_FFI_CMAKE=$SRC_DIR/tvm_ffi_override
          mkdir -p $TVM_FFI_CMAKE
          sed -e "s|\${TVM_FFI_DIR}|${TVM_FFI_DIR}|g" -e "s|\${SHLIB_EXT}|${SHLIB_EXT}|g" \
            $RECIPE_DIR/tvm_ffi-cross.cmake.in > $TVM_FFI_CMAKE/tvm_ffi-config.cmake
          export CMAKE_ARGS="$CMAKE_ARGS -Dtvm_ffi_ROOT=$TVM_FFI_CMAKE"
          # 2. Disable stub generation post-build step (it uses ctypes.CDLL to load the
          #    cross-compiled library which fails: arm64 lib on x86_64 host).
          sed 's/STUB_DIR.*STUB_INIT ON//' cpp/tvm_ffi/CMakeLists.txt > cpp/tvm_ffi/CMakeLists.txt.tmp
          mv cpp/tvm_ffi/CMakeLists.txt.tmp cpp/tvm_ffi/CMakeLists.txt
        fi
    - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
    - if: unix
      then: |
        if [[ "${CONDA_BUILD_CROSS_COMPILATION:-}" == "1" ]]; then
          bash $RECIPE_DIR/create_ffi_stubs.sh
        fi

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - scikit-build-core >=0.10.0
        - apache-tvm-ffi >=0.1.9
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake
    - ninja
    - if: unix
      then:
        - make
  host:
    - python
    - scikit-build-core >=0.10.0
    - pip
    - apache-tvm-ffi >=0.1.9
    - setuptools_scm
  run:
    - python
    - apache-tvm-ffi >=0.1.9
    - numpy >=1.26.0
    - ninja
    - pydantic
    - sentencepiece
    - tiktoken
    - pytorch >=1.10.0
    - transformers >=4.38.0
    - typer
    - typing_extensions >=4.9.0
    - if: linux and x86_64
      then: triton
    - if: osx and arm64
      then: mlx-lm

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - xgrammar
      # pip_check disabled: on osx-arm64, mlx-lm's own wheel metadata requires
      # mlx>=0.32.2, but conda-forge's mlx-lm recipe only constrains mlx>=0.31.2
      # and no mlx>=0.32.2 build exists yet, so `pip check` always fails here
      # even though the resolved environment works fine. Tracked upstream in
      # the mlx-lm-feedstock, not fixable from this recipe.
      pip_check: false

  - script:
      # cohere_melody (upstream's "test" extra, used only by the MELODY:cmd5 alignment
      # cases in test_builtin_structural_tag_alignment.py) is PyPI-only and not
      # packaged on conda-forge. It's an optional test dependency upstream, so we
      # don't add it here; instead, those specific cases are deselected below.
      #
      # "metal" (osx-arm64 only) deselects test_apply_token_bitmask_inplace_kernel[metal]:
      # the test's skip condition only checks that MPS/MLX are present, but the Azure
      # macOS CI runners' Metal compiler toolchain is too old to JIT-compile the
      # "metal4.0" shader MLX emits, so the test fails there regardless.
      - python -m pytest tests/ -m "not hf_token_required" -k "not MELODY and not cohere_melody and not metal"
    files:
      source:
        - tests/
    requirements:
      run:
        - ninja
        - protobuf
        - pytest
        - huggingface_hub
        - numpy >=1.26.0
        - pydantic
        - sentencepiece
        - tiktoken
        - pytorch >=1.10.0
        - transformers >=4.38.0

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/mlc-ai/xgrammar
  summary: XGrammar is an open-source library for efficient, flexible, and portable structured generation.
  license: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-4-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - NOTICE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - zbowling
    - Ubospica
    - LeeNethertonQC
    - pb01ka
